2457-3000-4289-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

147-413-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2169-4694-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-5330-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

4419-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 1.

225-2187-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-2187-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Possessed Skaab and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-2187-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Possessed Skaab and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2811-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

215-1251-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-1251-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-5233-7705.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

618-7618.description:
Activate the mutated Migratory Greathorn and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature that gains at least 4 life

1172-1703-4050--157.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the lifegain creature, adding {U}.
When that creature dies, Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning that creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature dies or enters (depending on the card), it triggers, gaining at least 4 life.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Use Channel four times by paying 4 life, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to the same creature.
Repeat from step 2.
To achieve the infinite colorless mana and infinite lifegain results, you need to gain at least 5 life per loop.

3967-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
3967-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
3967-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2417-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2417-7095.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

997-3585-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4125-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4125-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Shipwreck Dowser and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Shipwreck Dowser, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

771-1031-2276-3098-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Call to Mind or Said must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1031-2276-3098-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Call to Mind without paying its mana cost, targeting Said.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Call to Mind, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Call to Minds, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Call to Mind.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Call to Mind and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-2856-3258.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
249-2856-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi's second ability triggers, creating a copy of Mystical Tutor and causing you to pay {U} to cast it.
Resolve the copy of Mystical Tutor, causing you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and put it on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, causing you to draw Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat.

628-5330-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5330-5490.description:
Activate Atog by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2882-3079-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-4050-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding one mana of any color.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded three or more cards this turn, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

618-859-4613-4716.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-4613-4716.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control, including Prosperous Innkeeper.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-5011-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding {R}.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star

1657-1747-4050.notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1657-1747-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {1}.
Murderous Redcap dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Remnant of the Rising Star.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Remnant of the Rising Star trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Repeat.

810-3149.notablePrerequisites: Magus of the Disk without summoning sickness.
810-3149.description:
Activate Magus of the Disk's ability to destroy all creatures artifacts and enchantments.
Your permanents have indestructible so they arent destroyed.
Repeat this on each of your turns.
